<parameter=code>
def find_hole(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']==2:
            bb=[min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])]
            return (bb[0]+2,bb[1]+2)
    return None
def blobs(f):
    return sorted((min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']),min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']))
                 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
# cage top-left blob (15,13)
